theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01WitnessPrepGlobalBase.ntm_haltsWithin_mono
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (machine : MCore.Real.NTM State Symbol) (config : MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol)   {m n : Nat}, m ≤ n → machine.HaltsWithin m config → machine.HaltsWithin n config

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01WitnessPrepGlobalBase.runBranches_add
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (machine : MCore.Real.NTM State Symbol) (m n : Nat)   (configs : List (MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol)),   machine.runBranches (m + n) configs = machine.runBranches n (machine.runBranches m configs)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01WitnessPrepGlobalBase.runBranches_terminal_fixed
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (machine : MCore.Real.NTM State Symbol)   (configs : List (MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol)),   (∀ (c : MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol),       c ∈ configs → machine.accepting c.state = true ∨ machine.rejecting c.state = true) →     ∀ (fuel : Nat), machine.runBranches fuel configs = configs
